name: merchant-listing-automation
description: Draft-only ecommerce listing automation for merchant product uploads.

interface.shortDescription: Generate and fill ecommerce listing drafts safely.
interface.longDescription: Turns product information into platform-ready listing drafts, then guides Chrome/Computer Use automation to fill merchant back offices. Publishing, price changes, refunds, and shipping always require human confirmation.
